description:
Xposed module that skips the confirm step after face unlock

Xposed module that skips the "tap to confirm" dialog Android shows after face unlock. It taps confirm for you in System UI, so it works in all apps.

Requirements

  • Android 10 (API 29) or newer
  • Xposed framework with libxposed API 101 (recent LSPosed)
  • AOSP or close-to-stock ROM. OEM skins like MIUI or One UI may not work.
